tasks.instruction: Pick up the banana from the white table in front of you and place it on the white table behind you.
Strike the target in front of you, first with your right hand, then with your left hand.
Push the cart in front forward for a certain distance.
Move the gray box from the right-hand table to the white table.
Walk over to the large orange steps and sit down on them.
Kick the football into the goal
Use your left hand to place the orange fruit on the left into the plate, then use your right hand to place the purple fruit on the right into the plate.
Open the blue section at the front, take the green apple out of the tray and place it in the drawer, then close the drawer.
